experiment.name: kda_dataflow_comparison
experiment.hypothesis: Persistent local state and fused scheduling reduce single-head batch-1 KDA latency versus generic multi-pass dataflows.
experiment.scope: One D=128 recurrent head, batch=1, identical fixed-point recurrence, q/k/v 8-bit and state 24-bit.
experiment.quality_gate: Specialized row-lane result must match the software oracle with zero mismatches; proxy rows must be labelled analytical.
experiment.transfer_limit: This does not measure B300, Vera Rubin, CUDA, or full Kimi K3 throughput.

rows.name: specialized_kda_row_lanes
rows.notes: Persistent banked state; fused recurrence and readout.

rows.name: generic_simt_vector_proxy
rows.notes: Separate vector passes with global synchronization and state traffic.

rows.name: tiled_tensor_core_proxy
rows.notes: 16x16 tile schedule; better with batch or many independent heads.

rows.name: tiled_tensor_resource_matched_proxy
rows.notes: Same tile schedule scaled to the measured 56-DSP budget.
